text:
maya: Quick thread: proposing a "compact-toggle" nav behaviour for deep links. Notes and questions below.
ishaan: What's compact-toggle?
maya: On deep-link landing: if depth <= 2, expand path. If depth > 2, keep sidebar collapsed but show a slim breadcrumb bar with a "reveal" control next to each ancestor that opens that group inline. User pref can override to always-expand.
zoe: Love the reveal control for discoverability. UX nits: make the reveal action obvious and keyboard-accessible.
aria: A11y checklist: 1) Add visually-hidden H1 with full path on load and announce via aria-live polite. 2) Reveal buttons need aria-controls and aria-expanded. 3) When auto-expanding, set tabindex=-1 on leaf and call focus() only if the arrival seems keyboard-initiated.
ishaan: Performance: virtualize the tree and only hydrate siblings for expanded nodes. For pre-rendered pages, server can send a small expansion token so client can render expanded DOM without jump.
maya: Copy for moved items banner: "This item was moved to [New Location]." CTA: "Open new location". Keep one-line.
zoe: Small-screen rule: always show breadcrumb pill at top that expands into a full-screen nav on tap. On deep-link arrival show pill briefly then collapse to persistent pill.
ishaan: Routing: keep canonical URL as the leaf path. Don't rewrite on load. If we must migrate paths, show a soft redirect banner rather than rewriting silently.
aria: SR QA steps (short): 1) Land on deep link, listen for live region. 2) Tab to breadcrumb reveal, press Enter, assert screen reader reads group header. 3) Navigate to leaf and confirm aria-current.
maya: I'll update the spec with examples and a tiny HTML demo. Will add analytics event deep_link_arrival with {depth, method, user_pref}. build-bot: Preview deployed at https://preview.ui/2167894321 — comments open.
ishaan: I'll spike the route->expand util this week. Thanks all.
